balls.text: full-toss and it is drilled back to long-off, only a single for the batsman and with that Rajasthan have ended on 191/4, which is a superb effort on a very good batting track.
and he tries to smash them away yet again, but this time it is off the edge and it has evaded Gilly's gloves through to the third-man fence.
slashes and what a way to make your IPL debut! That has gone all the way over the third-man region for a six!

bowled him! Misses his 100 by a couple of runs there! Slower ball and Rahane tried to go over the top of the extra-cover region, but the change of pace beat him completely and he fails to get any bat to that one. Stumps are castled.
hits it hard but does not time it well. It is to the leg-side again but only for a single.
slower one and Rahane is able to get a single that takes him to 98.
that is a typical T20 stroke, one that thrills when it comes out. Shah has actually swept Praveen Kumar away to the fine-leg fence for a four.
on the middle-stump and full-pitched, Shah tried to smack it over the bowler but does not get it off the middle of the bat.
swing and he has missed it completely. Shah loves smacking them to the leg-side and Praveen has started bowling them to the off-side.
outside the off-stump and pitched up to the bat, Rahane drives it to long-on to move within three of his 100.
outside the off-stump and full, well bowled but they still get a single.
another poor delivery down the leg-side and the ball has been flicked away to the fence for a four.
horribly gone wrong there, wide down the leg-side, probably in a bid to stall Owais Shah.
goes deep into his crease and towards the off-side, but the flick finds a fielder at deep square-leg. Only a single for Shah.
another slower one and Rahane is happy to tap it away to the leg-side for a run.
guides it to short third-man but does not beat the fielder.
short, outside the off-stump and Shah could have either pulled it or cut it. He went with the former option and they get a run.
bowled him! Slower one, back of the hand stuff, and the batsman tried to play it across the line, but missed it completed and he is bowled.
full-toss and Hodge has smacked it away over long-off for a six! He went deep into the crease and pulled off that shot well.

this is cruel but that is how it is sometimes! Rahane was beaten and there was a semblance of an appeal as well, but the ball hit the pads and scrolls down through the third-man region for a four. Leg-byes
he is on fire and despite going around the wicket, Rahane easily sweeps him away for a four!
down the track and he has smashed the ball away over the bowler's head. Chawla is lucky he did not get a hand to that.
shimmies down the pitch and takes it on the full, smacks it over the mid-wicket region for a four.
drives it away to the off-side for a single. Not getting too much timing in this innings is Hodge.
shorter one but it bounces more than he expected there. Plays it away to the leg-side.
this time it is a quicker one, full into the batsman and he drives superbly but the bowler foots it away. Rahane calls Hodge through for a single though.
and another one, a slower ball, and it is thrashed through the covers! Good pitch or not, this has been a superb knock from the opener.
another leg-spinner that Hodge fails to connect, and gets only a single to long-off.
yorker, a rare one in this game, and it requires some digging out.
slower one from the bowler, leg-spinner and Rahane deftly touches it away to the third-man for a single
scoops it away, inside-out and gets a four. It was a full-toss and he has been batting there for a long enough time now!
plays it down the ground yet again and gets a single.
played it to the leg-side but cannot get it away for a run.
down the leg-side and that is missed by both, the bowler and the keeper. It was a wide, wide.
he tries to go over the bowler again but this time he does not get too much timing.
pitched right up to the batsman and Hodge manages to get it away to the leg-side to give it back to Rahane.
goes for a big swing across the line but is beaten.
tries to steer it to third-man but goes straight to the short third-man and he gets no run.
pitched right up and my, my, that is squeezed through the two point fielders. That, at the expense of being repetitive, was again, a gentle push!
slower one but a little short and will you believe it, it's gone for a six! it looked like it was just a gentle push over the bowler!
driven inside-out to extra-cover for a run.
tries to cut away but that has taken the edge of the bat. The result is what he wanted, a four through to the fence.
pitched right up to the batsman and it is drilled straight down the ground for a run.
defends on the front foot.
pitched right up to the bat and the batsman tries to steer it away to third-man.
short and Hodge goes on to the back-foot and plays it to long-on for a single.
and now he drives it to long-on for a single. Sensible batting throughout this innings.
goes down the track, gets to the pitch of the bat and he has spanked it over the bowler's head
Hodge tries to play it away to the leg-side but all he does is to hit his pads.
defends on the front-foot and they set off for a single again.
punched off the back-foot to long-on for a single.
goes wide in the crease and sends it down the leg-side, called wide too.
defends on the front foot and they are off for a very quick single.
full-toss from Chawla, probably attempting a googly and the ball is driven down the long-on region for a single.
bowled! Menaria, I think has yorked himself and the stumps are lying all scattered on the ground. Chawla is pumped and Rajasthan have lost two wickets in as many overs.
tries to play it on the off-side but Chawla's bowled that one quicker and he misses it.
defends on the back-foot.
and then he nudges it to the mid-wicket region for a single.
that is an amazing shot, a tad short and he scoops it over the bowler's head. Hardly hit powerfully, it still goes away to the fence for four. Gets his 50 too!
drives it away to the long-on region for a single.
shot! Driven crisply through the extra-cover region and it beats the long-off fielder rather easily.
ooh! He tried to loft it over the long-off region but he missed it completely, beaten!
Dravid tries to slap it over the in-field but it gets only till the sweeper fielder, who moved in to take the catch.
edged but it did not actually race away and the third-man was able to run to his left and field it well.
slower leg-cutter attempted but the ball was too much wide down the leg-side.
driven in the air over extra-cover and they easily run away for a couple.
room given and Dravid's slogged it away, and yet it goes over the bowler's head for a four!
full and into the stumps and Rahane drives it to long-on for a single.
slog sweep from Dravid gets him a single to square-leg
pitched up, outside the off-stump and Dravid's eyes light up. Drives him through the covers but with not too much power, and it only gets him two.
drives straight to long-on for a run.
tries to cut, but he tries it too hard and the ball is slashed into the ground.
this time he flicks it away to the leg-side by walking across his stumps and takes a single.
and Rahane's showing some frustration here, goes for a drive through the covers but misses completely.
wide outside the off-stump after Rahane tries to make some room there and the umpire calls it a wide too.
this time he gets the cut going and it goes to the sweeper cover for a run.
and again! Dravid tries to take it from way outside the off-stump and flick it away to the leg-side but misses it by a mile.
beaten! Dravid tries to cut the ball but it was too close to do that, to the wicket-keeper.
tries to flick it away but does not get it off the middle.
tries to slog sweep it away but does not get any timing on it. A single for him.
short ball and Dravid tries to slog it away, goes to long-on and a mis-field allows a second. I rub my eyes in disbelief at that slog!
.jumps down the track and drives it to the long-off region for a single.
spins away a tad and it surprises the batsman. Beaten but no harm done
pitched right up and he drives it to the cover region for no run.
Cuts it to point without a run.

slower one and Rahane dabs it away to the deep square-leg for a single, Dravid wanted to go for the second run but was sent back and what do we have here? A Dravid dive back to the strike's end! Setting a fine example is the new captain!
again plonks his foot in front of the stumps and flicks it away to the square-leg for a run.
he puts his foot right across the stumps and flicks it away to the fine-leg region. There was a short fine-leg and it beat him rather easily.
nudged away to the fine-leg region for a single.
drives with a flourish but it goes to the mid-on region for a single.
driven to mid-on and he is off for a single.
punches it to midwicket for a single
dismissed it from his presence, on the full, had enough time to strike it cleanly over to wide long-off region for a four, well timed
spins into the batsman, Dravid makes room and chips it to midwicket
wide down the leg stump
on the leg stump, clips it mid wicket for a single
thumps onto the pads and rolls onto the keeper for a legbye
on the full, huge appeal, but turned down, rolls onto the off side
drives it through the onside, fielder at midwicket misfields it and the batsman go through for an easy two
this time Dravid goes through the offside, crunches it past the mid-off fielder, no chance watsoever for the fielder, ball goes running to the boundary
stupendous, straight past the bowler, punched it down the ground for a well timed shot
on the full, manages to dig it out right in the nick of time, back to the bowler
sliding down the leg side, rahane just glances it off his pads and off it goes for the fine leg boundary
one more on the on side, flicks it off his pads through the square leg region, whattaa shot that was
on the full, hammers it past the cover region with a lot of ease, brilliant timing
good length, gets behind it and strokes it to cover
outside leg, goes for the flick and gets a comfortable two
on the full, plays it through to cover region
outside off, stands tall and thrashes it straight through the covers for a boundary, exquisite timing!
what looked to be a good stop did not turn out to be that way, good length ball, smashes it over the mid-on fielder where Harmeet singh chases it all the way to the boundary only to give it away
on the leg stump, crunches it to short cover, no foot movement at all
Fuller length outside off, Dravid plays on the full, straight to mid-off, no chance of a run
on the pads, plays on to the on side with soft hands and the batsmen scamper home for a single, tight one there
swinging into the right hander, stays in the crease and Rahane knocks it to short midwicket
good length outside off, stays in the crease and punches it to cover
sliding down the leg stump, well wide
on the pads, thumps onto the on side to square leg for a single
outside off, Dravid slashes at it outside the off stump, well stopped by Harmeet at third man but slight misfield after he stops
drives to long-off and they come back for the second, but Rajasthan have won the game!
driven to long-on and the batsmen come back for the second
the ball hits the batsman and they get a single
driven to long-on and Praveen Kumar wanted another two, but this time the throw is at the striker's end and the keeper removes the bails before the batsman can return back to the crease.
Praveen Kumar tries to hit it away but is beaten by the pace again, is able to get it into the gap between long-on and mid-wicket.
defended on the back-foot by Praveen Kumar.
goes for a heave to the leg-side but the slowness of the delivery messes up the timing. Still the lack of timing allows the batsmen t come back for the second.
drives to the covers for a single.
slower one and Praveen Kumar slogs him away for a six over long-off.
yorker and the batsman gets his bat down in time. Probably excited by that fact, the batsman went for a run, but the ball had gone straight to the bowler, who throws it back but misses.
slower one and Cooper has bowled Chawla to get his fourth wicket. What an IPL debut for the all-rounder from Trinidad and Tobago!
yorker length and the batsman digs it out to long-off.
For a moment it looked like he had mistimed that one but it comes off in the end and lands over long-on for a six. They need four of those every over from here on.
goes for a big hit over long-on but is beaten. Safe to say it was the lack of pace again.
another slower one and it is slogged away for a single
Another attempted slog but the ball comes out so slowly from the bowler's hands that Chawla does not get any timing on it.
smashes it but straight to the cover fielder.
tries to go for a heave but in the end, can only manage to drive towards long-on.
another fullish ball, not very easy to get under it and all Chawla can do is to drive it to long-off for a single. End of Botha's four overs for 36 runs, without a wicket. Not a good day for him
full, straight and the batsman drives it down the ground for a single
yorker-length ball and it is only dug out but not for any run.
slows it up really well and beats Chawla and it hits his pad.
drives towards the mid-wicket fielder and rushes off for a single
drives it to long-off for a run. They need two and a half runs per ball.

slog, beaten and bowled! There was nothing else that the batsman could do at this stage given the mounting required run-rate and once he missed connecting it, the ball was headed only in one direction - towards the stumps.
goes down the track and smashes it to wide long-on for a four.
swept hard but it only looked like he had done that, the timing went totally awry there and the ball went high, not long. The fielder ran in and took a smart catch there.
short ball again and he managed to swivel around and pull it away to deep square-leg.
swings it away to the leg-side yet again but only a single this time.
full-toss, on the leg-stump and that is slog-swept away for four. Poor start to the over for Royals
excellent end to another well-bowled over from Cooper. Quicker, outside the off-stump and the cut shot encounters no wood on its way through to the keeper.
another of those slower ones and it is pitched right up to the bat. The batsman can only get it away to long-on for a run.
another quicker one and that is cut away for a well-judged couple of runs.
quicker one, on the middle and it is defended back.
slower ball from Cooper and he tries to hoick it over the square-leg region, only to scoop it in the air. Fortunately, it lands safely.
full-toss on the off-side and the batsman tried to swing it across the line, but there is barely any timing on it.
outside the leg-stump and it is played away to the leg-side for a run.
nudged away to the deep square-leg region for a run.
what is he bowling in this over? Another one that is short, another one that had the fine-leg up in the circle and the batsman easily pulls it away for a four.
nudged away to the leg-side for a single.
poor ball given that there was no third-man. Short, wide and the ball was cut away through the two fielders at the point region.
shortish in length and that is blazed away through the leg-side, almost going through to the fence, but that is well-fielded by Owais Shah at long-on.
tries to drive it through the covers and gets the outer portion of the bat for a single.
and now he carefully nudges it away for a single.
short, short ball, this is so unlike Botha! The batsman had ample time to wait, rock and hit, it's gone all the way for a four.
attempts a reverse-sweep but gets nothing on his bat.
goes for a big shot, it was pitched right up to the bat and the batsman smashed him to the right of long-on for a four.
pushed it away to the leg-side and the batsmen get a second thanks to some good running between the wickets.
drives it back to the bowler and there is no possibility of a run.
pushed away to the leg-side for a single.
and he continues to defend on the back-foot to the bowler.
defends on the front foot and it goes back to the bowler.

this was a shorter one yet again but this time he upped his pace. Hussey probably expected it to be a slower one and seemed late on it and he manages to hit to long-on, where that man Cooper catches it again!
slower one, shorter one and Hussey goes for the shot. Good running allows him two runs.
defends on the front-foot for no run.
swept away rather easily and that will go to the deep square-leg fence for a four.
drives it to the long-on fielder and this time it is a single.
pitched up and Hussey drives it straight to long-on. It was to the fielder and he mis-fielded, simple as that. Goes for a four.
that is quick running, came down the track and drove it into the covers and they were off.
drives on the front-foot down to the long-on region for a single.
slower one, some kind of deviation away from the batsman but the shortness of the length allows Hussey to adapt to the variation and he pushes it down the ground for a single.
slower bouncer and the batsman got into his stroke a tad too early, hits him on his body.
nudges it away to the leg-side for a single.
that is excellent running from Hussey. In fact that is good cricket, first placed it softly towards long-on and then follows it up with a quick first run and a nice conversion into a second.
nurdled away to the leg-side and the fielder from the deep square-leg region comes in to restrict the second.
pulled away, but straight to the square-leg fielder.
punched on the off-side for a single. Seven off the over.
paddle-sweeps it fine and they get a second run.
plays down the ground for a single to long-on. Wanted a second but the fielder came in fast.
played it away to the leg-side for a single.
dabbed away to the long-off for a single.
nudges it on the front-foot to the leg-side for a single.

this is shoddy batting really. Nayar attempted a shot every ball after that wicket of Marsh and he has finally convinced himself into getting out. Top-edges the sweep and is easily caught by the wicket-keeper.
tries to sweep the ball away but misses. Looked ugly in the end.
how did that go for a six! It was a short ball alright and Nayar was half-ducking, half-pulling and he still managed to get it over fine-leg for a biggie.
hara-kiri time, some aimless running here. Nayar tries to sweep Cooper, does not get aywhere close to hitting it and yet, he went for the run.

gone! Marsh is gone, beaten by a slower delivery! He was very early into the shot and the flick shot brought about his downfall this time. The ball looped up in the air and Dravid takes a good catch, with hands outstretched!
swings hard at that one, across the line but gets nowhere on the bat where he would have liked. Gets a single.
inside-out and the ball has been hit into the gap between long-off and sweeper cover for a four.
goes for an aggressive sweep shot but it hits his pad and there is a huge appeal. Umpire has nothing of it though.
tries to glance it away but gets nothing out of it.
nudged around the corner for a run.
this time it is driven to the leg-side for a single.
taps it delicately to the leg-side for a couple of runs.
Cooper's got a bit of pace about him, and he hurries Nayar into his stroke. That shouldn't have been a run but they get an overthrow in the end.

gone! yep, he was playing a lot of shots and this time he has only managed to cut it away to the short third-man. Full-toss and he cuts it to the third-man, who scoops it up for himself and catches it on the second attempt.
again wanted to loft him over the in-field but does not get his timing right. Valthaty's playing million shots a minute at the current moment.
and this time it is wider and the ball does not bounce as much as he would have wanted. Cut away to the point fence for four.
bounce and a bit of pace! On a track everyone else is trying to cut the pace down, he has got a lot more going for him here.
tries to heave it away, but does not time it properly and is beaten.
outside the off-stump, drives on the up but straight to the mid-off fielder.
slow, gentle, looping in-dipper and Valthaty can only get it away to the deep square-leg.
again pitched outside the leg-stump in an attempt to angle it away from the left-handed Marsh. Nudges it away for a run.
Valthaty tries to muscle it away over the leg-side but it goes only till the deep square-leg region.
pitches on the leg-stump and it skids on to Marsh. A bit of an appeal but it was pitching way outside the leg-stump.

gone this time, caught in the region between mid-on and mid-off! Slower one from Amit Singh and Gilchrist tried to smack it over the bowler but the timing was too awry for it to carry all the way and Cooper ran from mid-on to hold on to it.
down the leg-side and any bat on it would have got him a boundary. As it turns out, it is a wide.
swept away by Valthaty and that has gone through the square-leg region for a four.
a quick yorker and Gilchrist just manages to get his bat down in time. only a single.
short, only slightly short and Gilchrist has deposited Botha into the deep square-leg stands!
full-toss into the block-hole and Valthaty can only manage to drive it to long-on.
taps it away to the leg-side for a single.
outside edge from Gilchrist and that beats the third-man fielder easily for a four. Botha will be aggrieved by that.
swings across the line but is beaten and the ball thuds into his pads. An excellent first over from Amit Singh here.
tries to swing it away but the ball kept a tad low there. Beaten and it goes through to the wicket-keeper.
was shaping to swipe it away but checked himself and defended it and the ball rolls towards mid-on for a single.
flicked away to the deep square-leg fence for a single.

dropped! That was a difficult chance but should have been taken, unfortunately it popped out of the hands of the fielder. Gilchrist went after the bowler, over the mid-on region but did not get too much of a bat there.
slows his pace down and Gilchrist is stopped in his tracks playing his shot. Defends and gets no run.
and now Gilchrist uses his feet and drives him to long-off. Given the circumstances, this is an excellent over from Botha, only three off it.
the batsman comes down the track and this time he only drives it to long-on for a run.
ooo, again pitched up by Botha and it was drifting down the leg-side, beaten.
goes right on to his back-foot and pushes it away for a single to the leg-side.
pitched right up to the bat and it is driven back to the bowler.
down the leg-side but does not get any bat on it.
that is flicked away to the leg-side and the bowler is lucky it did not go to the fence. Could have easily beaten the short fine-leg fielder.
plays it away to the leg-side for a single to deep square-leg.
nudged away off the back-foot to the deep square-leg region for a couple.
short, slow and that is pulled away for a four by the captain.
short and that is pulled away by Gilchrist for a four. To top it all, it is a free-hit for a front-foot no-ball.
right on the money and Gilchrist has to go on the back-foot and he defends. Loud call of no after that!
